description:
Scan any website for SEO issues directly from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client.

**What it does:** Audits any URL for SEO, performance, accessibility, and AI search visibility. Returns structured
issues with fix prompts you can apply immediately.

**Tools:**
- `scan_website` — scan any URL, get issues with fix instructions
- `get_scan` — retrieve previous scan results

**40+ checks:** title, meta, H1, canonical, Open Graph, Core Web Vitals, alt text, structured data, llms.txt, E-E-A-T
signals, and more.

From $19/month for 50 page scans.
